title: The Space Where Removed Things Find Their Names

features.name: cabinet of unshelving
features.desc-on-touch: Forms that file themselves by what they no longer are, each slot a name that only exists in its not-being.

features.name: plaque of erasure
features.desc-on-touch: A wall-mounted glyph where the carved names have worn through to white stone beneath.

features.name: tower of what was
features.desc-on-touch: Pale blocks ascending in perfect silence, each one holding the weight of a single removed thing.

features.name: pool of witness
features.desc-on-touch: A pool that catches light where nothing was taken; what pools in the shape of an absence.

features.name: ledger stand
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard rendering of infinite blank entries, each line waiting for a name that cannot be written.

features.name: phantom walker
features.desc-on-touch: A figure that moves through the space leaving no footfall, tracing the paths of things that were never here.

inscription: here the removed thing learns its true name in the space where nothing else will interfere

file.name: Ledger_of_Absences_1987.txt
file.note: Lines that list what was taken; over time each deletion corrupts the previous entry's name, layers of erasure becoming new text

exits.label: back eastward through the shape belief left
where the void deepens and asks for nothing
